ui_findings_from_rendered_review.title: Adversary header says 'no programme run yet' while the region displays a full programme
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.evidence: Rendered at 1440px with populated GET /red-team/programme. Top-right of the ADVERSARY region reads 'no programme run yet' while directly beneath it sit severity counts (1 critical / 1 high / 1 medium / 0 low), a three-row coverage table, and three findings with Contain buttons.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.why_it_matters: The page contradicts itself on screen. This is the same false-status class WIRE-03 existed to remove — it survived by living in a region header instead of an EmptyState, so check-ops-room-wiring.mjs does not catch it.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.fix_hint: The header status label is derived from the wrong source (likely latestRedTeamRun rather than the programme/open_findings query that populates the body). Derive both from one source.

ui_findings_from_rendered_review.title: Bench 'File' is irrevocable but visually identical to reversible Hold/Dismiss, with no staged confirmation
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.evidence: All three grade buttons render as equal-weight neutral buttons in the enlarger pane. bench_service.py:378 refuses any transition away from 'filed' and the route answers 409 — it is permanent, server-enforced.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.why_it_matters: Contain, also irreversible, correctly got the staged .cap-confirm treatment in 23-06. The bench did not. The one-way action is the easiest to hit by accident.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.fix_hint: Apply the same staged-confirm pattern to File only; leave Hold and Dismiss immediate. Locked copy should state that filing cannot be undone.

ui_findings_from_rendered_review.title: Red used as chrome rather than as a verdict in Retrieval health
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.evidence: Every reading-ledger row (BM25 TOP SCORE, VECTOR TOP SCORE, RRF, RERANK, RECALL@K, NDCG@10, MRR, CITED-CHUNK RANK, COMPACTION RATIO, CITATION COVERAGE) carries a maroon hairline rule, and the context-window utilisation bar renders red at 7.1% — a healthy value.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.why_it_matters: GOTHAM's single governing law is 'colour is a verdict'. Nothing in this region has failed. Painting neutral readings in the alarm colour is the same category of dishonesty as a false verdict chip.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.fix_hint: Hairlines should use the neutral engraved-rule token from 20-UI-SPEC.md §2.2. The utilisation bar should be bone/neutral unless it crosses a defined threshold.

ui_findings_from_rendered_review.title: '1 documents' — unpluralised count
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.evidence: Top-right of the RETRIEVAL HEALTH region with exactly one document.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.fix_hint: Singular/plural helper; check the other regions' count labels for the same bug while there.

ui_findings_from_rendered_review.title: 'Agent · Serving since —' renders an em-dash placeholder in the page header

ui_findings_from_rendered_review.why_it_matters: Reads as broken data rather than absent data, in the most prominent line on the page. The three-state law applies here too.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.fix_hint: Either omit the clause when the date is unknown, or state the absence in words.

ui_findings_from_rendered_review.title: Unguarded nested reads crash ALL SIX regions to an error boundary
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.evidence: page.tsx:560 reads res.scores.faithfulness.toFixed(2), and the run tiles read run.aggregate_scores.faithfulness, with no optional chaining. A payload missing either nested object produced 'This page couldn't load' — the whole ops room, not just the Judgement region. Reproduced twice during the rendered review.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.why_it_matters: An in-progress eval run, or any partial payload, takes down Live, Retrieval health, Bench, Judgement, Adversary and Prompt together. Everything else in this phase was built to degrade honestly; this one path does not degrade at all.
ui_findings_from_rendered_review.fix_hint: Guard the nested reads and render the region's own honest empty/loading state. Consider a per-region error boundary so one region's bad payload cannot blank the other five.

how_the_render_was_obtained.why_it_matters: Every executor in this phase reported 'no rendered verification' as a known limitation. This is how it was finally done, and the next session should not rediscover it.
blockers_solved: No PostgreSQL and no API server: irrelevant — Playwright page.route() intercepts at the network layer, so real backends are not needed.

Clerk auth: /agents/[id] gates every query on `isLoaded && !!isSignedIn && step1Done` (12 sites) and every queryFn throws 'Not authenticated' when getToken() returns null (17 sites). NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO=true only makes routes public via proxy.ts — it does NOT make the sub-routes demo-aware.
Route precedence: a catch-all glob competing with specific globs is ambiguous in either registration order. Use ONE page.route('**/api/v1/**') handler that switches on URL pathname.
Port 3100 had a stale dev server from the 23-08 executor returning 500; killing it also released ~1.2 GB of held .next files.
how_the_render_was_obtained.method: Temporarily relax the 12 enabled-gates and the 17 getToken sites to accept a demo fallback, run `next dev -p 3100` with NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO=true, drive it with a throwaway Playwright spec whose single router returns realistic payloads, screenshot fullPage at 1440, then `git checkout --` every touched file and delete the harness.
payload_shapes_that_bit: EvalRunSummary needs nested aggregate_scores.{faithfulness,...} — NOT flat.
EvalScenarioResult needs nested scores.{faithfulness,...} — NOT flat.
/prompt-versions/diff needs the DiffSide/fields shape, not the versions list — match it BEFORE the /prompt-versions rule.
how_the_render_was_obtained.revert_status: FULLY REVERTED. `git status --short -- apps/admin/` is empty; zero NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO or demo-token residue under app/agents/[id]/; tests-review/ and playwright.review.config.ts deleted. Both gates re-verified green after revert.

decisions.decision: Renamed this phase's requirement ids INT-01..05 -> WIRE-01..05 before execution
decisions.rationale: REQUIREMENTS.md:324-329 already assigns INT-01..06 to Phase 16's integration adapters. Minting a colliding set in the same breath as the v1.2 audit flagged the OPS-01..06 collision as 'a standing generator' of wrong ticks was indefensible. WIRE- verified unused repo-wide first; Phase 16's ids verified intact after. Commit 7af761d.

Each region plan creates its component AND mounts it, so no seam crosses a wave at all — a stronger form of the lesson than 'the later plan owns the wiring', which is the lesson this phase exists because the project failed to apply across phases.
